message: Proposed minimal V15 import for the newly isolated Capture P0 seam: laneId capture-build-authority-helper-execution. Objective: add exact-current expected-red coverage for same-UID substitution of build-side provenance/generated-subject helper code, then repair normal bootstrap and capture_tuya_private_input_build_guard so authority semantics execute only from exact accepted source bytes/Git blobs bound to the candidate source, preserving the already-pinned private-review HMAC verifier and existing generated/private evidence contracts. Keep this distinct from #2805 (private-review verifier custody) and #2775 (Final-GO/control-side generated helper custody). Suggested owned production paths are Scripts/bootstrap_capture_tuya_sdk.sh and Scripts/capture_tuya_private_input_build_guard.py; tests/workflows should be narrowly scoped. Acceptance should require expected-red-before-repair, repaired exact-head green for both provenance-helper and generated-helper substitution attacks, existing #2805 private-review suites green, field-provenance/generated-subject gates green, independent review, no temporary/generated residue, and explicit PHYSICAL NO-GO until final flagship composition/issuer gates. This is a reconciliation recommendation only; no lane file was created because reconciliation ownership is active elsewhere.
